def repair_statusline(settings_path, command):
    """Point statusLine.command back at the observer if another tool replaced it."""
    with open(settings_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        settings = json.load(handle)
    settings.setdefault("statusLine", {})["command"] = command
    with open(settings_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(settings, handle, indent=2)
